item.title: MOCK: Active learning cuts formulation trials for recycled polypropylene blends
item.content:encoded:
MOCK ARTICLE. We study recycled polypropylene (rPP) blends from three suppliers.

Methods

An active learning loop with a Gaussian process surrogate proposed 48 formulations across 6 resin lots.

Results

The loop reached the target melt flow index in 19 experiments versus 41 for a full factorial baseline.

Don't over-read this: validation used one extruder.
